disease.name: Gastric adenocarcinoma + Esophageal cancer (squamous + adenocarcinoma) + Crohn's-pathway amendment
disease.full_name_gastric: Adenocarcinoma of the stomach (TCGA-STAD molecular subtypes: CIN chromosomal-instability, MSI microsatellite-instability hypermutator, EBV Epstein-Barr-virus-associated CIMP-high, GS genomically-stable mostly diffuse-Lauren, POLE polymerase-epsilon-mutant ultramutator)
disease.full_name_esophageal: Carcinoma of the esophagus (TCGA-ESCA two histological subtypes: ESCC esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma + EAC esophageal adenocarcinoma)
disease.global_burden_gastric: Gastric cancer is the 5th most common cancer globally (~1.1M new cases/year per GLOBOCAN 2022) and 4th leading cause of cancer death (~770K deaths/year). Five-year survival in the US ~32%, driven primarily by late-stage diagnosis. Highest incidence in East Asia (China, Korea, Japan) where H. pylori prevalence and dietary risk factors are elevated. Bass et al. 2014 Cell defined the four-subtype TCGA molecular classification (CIN/MSI/EBV/GS) that remains the canonical molecular taxonomy.
disease.global_burden_esophageal: Esophageal cancer is the 8th most common cancer globally (~510K new cases/year per GLOBOCAN 2022) and 6th leading cause of cancer death (~445K deaths/year). Five-year survival ~20% globally, ~22% in the US. Two histologically distinct subtypes with different epidemiology: ESCC predominates in East Asia and is associated with smoking, alcohol, and hot-beverage consumption; EAC predominates in Western countries and is strongly associated with Barrett's esophagus + GERD + obesity (Krause et al. 2016 Nat Genet).
disease.global_burden_ibd_amendment: Inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's + UC) prevalence ~3 million in the US (CDC), with rising incidence globally. Diagnosed primarily by endoscopy with biopsy; no validated blood-based methylation signature deployed clinically as of 2026. Ventham et al. 2016 Nat Commun 7:13507 (PMID 27886173) is the largest published methylation cohort.
disease.primary_site_gastric: Stomach (antrum, corpus, fundus; cardia at gastroesophageal junction overlaps with EAC origin spectrum)
disease.primary_site_esophageal: Esophagus (squamous epithelium for ESCC; columnar Barrett's-derived metaplastic epithelium for EAC, predominantly distal third)
disease.primary_site_ibd_amendment: Whole blood + sorted lymphocytes/myeloid cells (peripheral immune-population signature; not a direct GI-tissue readout at v0.1)
disease.tissue_class_gastric: cycling (gastric adenocarcinoma primary tumor architectural drift); secretory (Boccellato gastric epithelial mucosoid sub-cell-type tiles, H_min=0.843264)
disease.tissue_class_esophageal: cycling (ESCA primary tumor architectural drift); secretory (EsoRef squamous epithelial sub-cell-type tiles, H_min=0.843264)
disease.healthy_reference_beta_esophageal_squamo: not in Moss 2018 18-tissue table; calibrated via VAL-124 EsoRef bridged atlas per-tile q5 thresholds (Epi_stratified q5 = 0.4202)
disease.biology_note_gastric: TCGA 2014 (Bass et al.) defined four molecular subtypes of gastric adenocarcinoma: (1) Chromosomal instability (CIN, ~50% of cases) characterized by intestinal-Lauren histology + recurrent TP53 mutations + chromosomal aneuploidy; (2) Microsatellite instability (MSI, ~22%) with hypermutator phenotype + DNA mismatch repair deficiency + elevated CIMP methylation; (3) Epstein-Barr virus-associated (EBV, ~9%) with extreme CIMP-high methylation + PIK3CA mutations + immune cell infiltration; (4) Genomically stable (GS, ~20%) with diffuse-Lauren histology + CDH1/RHOA mutations + low mutational burden. ACRG 2015 (Cristescu et al. Nat Med) extended this with prognostic stratification. The card-relevant prediction is that Stage 1 cycling-class architectural-drift readout will produce a within-cohort hierarchy MSI ≈ EBV (high CIMP) > CIN > GS (low methylation drift) consistent with high-CIMP-amplification of methylation drift signature.
disease.biology_note_esophageal: Two histologically and biologically distinct subtypes. ESCC arises from squamous-stratified esophageal epithelium typically in proximal-mid esophagus; risk factors smoking + alcohol + hot beverages + low fruit/vegetable intake; characterized by acute squamous transformation with TP53 mutations + cyclin D1 amplification (Hao et al. 2018 Mol Cancer Res). EAC arises from columnar Barrett's-derived metaplastic epithelium typically in distal third + gastroesophageal junction; risk factors GERD + obesity + Barrett's history; characterized by chronic CIMP-driven methylation drift accumulation through metaplasia → low-grade dysplasia → high-grade dysplasia → invasive adenocarcinoma sequence (Krause et al. 2016 Nat Genet; Yu et al. 2019 Front Genet; Kaz et al. 2011 Cancer Res). Card-relevant prediction: within-cohort EAC > ESCC on Stage 1 architectural-drift readout because EAC's chronic methylation drift accumulation exceeds ESCC's acute squamous transformation drift in cycling-class methylation space.
disease.biology_note_ibd_amendment: Crohn's and UC produce a peripheral-blood immune-population signature characterized by T-cell expansion (CD4 + CD8 + Treg) with proportional decrease in monocytes and neutrophils. The signature is captured by methylation-based cell-type deconvolution panels (Salas IDOL, Loyfer immune tiles, UniLIFE 19-cell, Caggiano TIM) detecting the population-fraction shift in mixed populations. The signature is NOT detected by Stage 1 cycling-class architectural-drift panel (which is tissue/cancer-specific). The signature is NOT detected by sorting cells (because the signature is in proportions, not in any single cell type's methylation pattern). Card-relevant prediction (sealed before VAL-128 β access): mixture-attenuation hypothesis (sorted ≥ 1.5x whole-blood). Observed: REVERSED direction — whole blood STRONGER than sorted because the IBD signature is a population-fraction shift, not within-cell-type drift.

module_1_stad_stage_1_findings.interpretation: All five molecular subtype rankings preserve the pre-locked CIMP-amplification ordering (MSI ≈ EBV > CIN > GS) within cohort. MSI slightly leads EBV by ~0.2 d-units (interpretable as MSI's hypermutator phenotype amplifying methylation drift modestly above EBV's pure CIMP). Within-cohort signals are robust to CHK-3.2 tier-3 substrate baseline shift because all subgroups share the same baseline. Some published literature reports EBV-leads-MSI on different methylation platforms — VAL-126 reports the observed direction with this interpretive note rather than claiming exact reproduction of any single published ordering.

module_2_esca_stage_1_findings.histology_contrast_interpretation: EAC architectural drift exceeds ESCC by 1.06 d-units within cohort (within-cohort signal robust to substrate baseline shift). Consistent with prereg hypothesis that EAC's Barrett's-driven chronic methylation drift exceeds ESCC's acute squamous transformation drift in cycling-class methylation space. First cookbook example of methylation-only within-cancer histological-subtype discrimination at this magnitude (1.06 d-units within cohort) outside MSI-tracking-Lauren cases.

barrett_within_cohort.interpretation: Cleanest within-cohort biological signal in the sprint. Barrett's history amplifies the architectural-drift signature by +1.69 d-units within the same cohort. Substrate-tier-3 doesn't apply because both groups share identical baseline. Biologically consistent: Barrett's esophagus is chronic columnar metaplasia with progressive methylation drift accumulation; tumors arising from Barrett's substrate inherit and amplify that drift signature.

smoking_within_cohort_informative_null.interpretation: All four smoking strata within 0.6 d-units of each other (range 2.43-3.03). Smoking status is NOT a strong driver of architectural-drift signal in this cohort, in marked contrast to Barrett's (1.69 d-unit amplification). Card-relevant finding: gastric-esophageal-epic v0.1 Stage 1 readout responds to chronic-methylation-drift drivers (Barrett's metaplasia, MSI-CIMP overlap) more strongly than to acute-mutagenic drivers (smoking-induced DNA damage). Distinguishes mechanism: methylation drift ≠ mutational burden.

module_3_crohns_stage_1_null.interpretation: INFORMATIVE NULL. Stage 1 Xu-538 cycling-class architectural-drift panel does NOT detect Crohn's in any cell-type strata. UC vs HC similarly near-null. Class-of-disease finding: IBD does not register on cycling-class Stage 1 panel. Stage 1 is tissue/cancer-specific (validated previously on TCGA-COAD, TCGA-LIHC, TCGA-STAD, TCGA-ESCA, GSE51057 breast) not generic chronic-inflammation marker.

module_1_stad.i_pooled_direction: POSITIVE (all 5 subtypes fire d > +2.88 within cohort; all-cohort d=+3.34). No bidirectional cancellation.
module_1_stad.ii_bidirectional_risk_with_citation: Low. STAD primary tumor methylation drift is monotonic positive across subtypes per Bass et al. 2014 Cell methylation profiling and Cristescu et al. 2015 Nat Med. CIMP-high MSI + EBV subtypes amplify drift relative to CIN; GS subtype dampens drift but stays positive.
module_1_stad.iii_directional_fallback: Not required at v0.1. Pooled A_immune fires consistently above 80-cell baseline reference NORMAL cutoff on all subtypes. Directional fallback panel reserved for diseases with bidirectional cancellation (AD-instance pattern per CCL-031, PDAC pooled-null per CCL-028).
module_1_stad.iv_lymphoid_myeloid_pattern_literature: T-cell + myeloid depletion bidirectional pattern in peripheral blood readout consistent with Lin et al. 2019 J Hepatol, Kang et al. 2020 Theranostics, Sundar et al. 2021 Nat Commun documenting peripheral T-cell exhaustion + reduced lymphocyte/myeloid blood-compartment proportions in advanced gastric cancer. Stage 3 Salas IDOL fires CD4T -1.92, CD8T -1.58, Mono -0.90, NK -0.86 — direction consistent with literature.

module_2_esca.i_pooled_direction: POSITIVE for both subtypes (ESCC d=+2.64, EAC d=+3.70 within cohort). Direction is monotonic positive across both subtypes; subtype discrimination is in magnitude not direction.
module_2_esca.ii_bidirectional_risk_with_citation: Low. EAC and ESCC both produce monotonic positive cycling-class methylation drift per Krause et al. 2016 Nat Genet (EAC Barrett's-CIMP) and Hao et al. 2018 Mol Cancer Res (ESCC squamous transformation).
module_2_esca.iii_directional_fallback: Not required at v0.1. Pooled A_immune fires consistently above 80-cell baseline.
module_2_esca.iv_lymphoid_myeloid_pattern_literature: ESCA Stage 3 immune-fraction readout pending v0.2 expansion; clinically expected mixed pattern with TIL infiltration in EAC (Lagisetty et al. 2021 Br J Cancer) + immune-suppressive microenvironment in advanced ESCC.

module_3_crohns_amendment.i_pooled_direction: Stage 1 NULL across all cell-type strata. Pooled A_immune does NOT detect IBD.
module_3_crohns_amendment.ii_bidirectional_risk_with_citation: Stage 3 readout is bidirectional by design (T-cell expansion UP, myeloid depletion DOWN). This is the operational signature, not a confound — it reflects population-fraction-shift biology of IBD per Strober et al. 2007 Nat Rev Immunol + Globig et al. 2014 J Crohns Colitis.
module_3_crohns_amendment.iii_directional_fallback: Not applicable. The IBD signature is captured by Stage 3 cell-fraction deconvolution atlases not by Stage 1 architectural-drift directionality.

module_1_stad_target_tissue.primary_target_class: cycling (per Moss 2018 18-tissue table) for tumor-vs-anchor cycling-class architectural-drift readout; secretory for sub-cell-type Boccellato gastric mucosoid tile readout
module_1_stad_target_tissue.score_formula_cycling: A_cycling = (1 - β_tumor / β_healthy) / (1 - H_min_cycling); A < 1.01 NORMAL, A ≥ 1.01 MARGINAL, A ≥ 1.05 DETECTABLE, A ≥ 1.07 URGENT, A ≥ 1.10 FLOOR_BREACH per universal_tier_thresholds (deviation justified per disease literature as appropriate)
module_1_stad_target_tissue.score_formula_boccellato_secretory: Per-tile A_secretory = mean(β over tile CpGs) / H_min_secretory; FLOOR_BREACH triggered when sample's per-tile A_secretory < q5 healthy floor for that tile (BELOW_NORMAL drift detection)
module_1_stad_target_tissue.localization_criterion: Boccellato tile fires within calibrated q5 floor range AND within-cohort molecular-subtype hierarchy (MSI ≈ EBV > CIN > GS) reproduces predicted ordering = high confidence gastric-adenocarcinoma localization. Substrate-tier-3 caveat applies to absolute Boccellato direction interpretation pending v0.2 substrate-matched gastric anchor.
module_1_stad_target_tissue.ambiguous_action: Under tier-3 substrate baseline shift, Boccellato POSITIVE_UNEXPECTED + Loyfer homogenization tile pattern + EsoRef cross-tissue overread = STAD adenocarcinoma differential (Pattern A in clinical_action_matrix) with GI-tissue cross-card differential considered (gastric vs esophageal-cardia vs distal-esophageal-EAC). v0.2 substrate-matched anchor clears the ambiguity.

module_2_esca_target_tissue.primary_target_class: cycling (primary tumor architectural drift); secretory (EsoRef squamous epithelial sub-cell-type tiles)
module_2_esca_target_tissue.esoref_target_tissue_finding_in_escc: Epi_stratified d=-0.99 in ESCC squamous-cell carcinoma (cell-of-origin retention signature in target tissue — squamous tumor retains methylation patterns consistent with squamous-stratified epithelial origin); Epi_upper d=-1.51 in ESCC further confirming target-tissue specificity. EAC reads near-null on Epi_stratified (d=-0.05). First cookbook example of a gene-promoter atlas reading its target biology in one disease subtype within the same multi-cohort sprint.
module_2_esca_target_tissue.score_formula_cycling: Same as module_1; A_cycling = (1 - β_tumor / β_healthy) / (1 - H_min_cycling)
module_2_esca_target_tissue.score_formula_esoref_secretory: Per-tile A_secretory = mean(β over tile CpGs) / H_min_secretory; FLOOR_BREACH triggered for cell-of-origin retention signature when sample's A_Epi_stratified < q5 healthy floor 0.4202 (below-normal direction = squamous-stratified epithelial origin retained, characteristic of ESCC)
module_2_esca_target_tissue.localization_criterion: (1) ESCC: Stage 1 elevated + EsoRef Epi_stratified BELOW q5 floor (cell-of-origin retention) + Loyfer Head_and_neck_larynx elevated = ESCC localization; (2) EAC: Stage 1 elevated + Caggiano TIM panel uniformly elevated + EsoRef Epi_stratified near-null + Barrett's positive covariate = EAC localization; (3) Subtype d_ESCC-EAC = -1.06 within cohort discriminates at p=1.50e-11.
module_2_esca_target_tissue.ambiguous_action: ESCC vs EAC discrimination is ROBUST in this card via Caggiano TIM panel (13+ tiles fire EAC > ESCC at ~2 d-units within cohort). Ambiguous case = EsoRef tiles fire WITHOUT clear ESCC retention pattern AND Caggiano TIM panel fires WITHOUT clear EAC > ESCC pattern → flag for review-pending; recommend EGD with biopsy for histological confirmation.

module_3_crohns_target_tissue.primary_target_tissue: Not applicable — module_3 is a Stage 3 readout in blood substrate, not a Stage 2 cell-of-origin tissue localization. The IBD signature is a peripheral-blood immune-population-fraction shift, not a cell-of-origin readout.
module_3_crohns_target_tissue.stage_2_role_for_module_3: INFORMATIVE NULL. Boccellato gastric tiles, EsoRef esophageal tiles, OEref oral tiles, Loyfer 25-tile, Caggiano TIM all read NULL on Crohn's blood cohort because the disease signature is in blood compartment composition, not in any GI-tissue methylation pattern. This is a class-of-disease structural finding documenting Stage 2 atlas family fitness for IBD.
module_3_crohns_target_tissue.localization_criterion: Not applicable for IBD detection at v0.1.
module_3_crohns_target_tissue.ambiguous_action: Crohn's blood signature is interpreted ONLY at Stage 3; if Stage 1 + Stage 2 fire WITH the Crohn's Stage 3 immune-population pattern, the patient may have a coincident GI cancer + IBD comorbidity (clinically plausible scenario per Marcus's stepbrother case: Crohn's history + HCC, see Heath's documented motivating case).

saturation_levels._formula: A_ceiling(class, substrate) = 1 / H_min(class, substrate). Per-class H_min_methyl values from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96 (G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001).
saturation_levels._runtime_flag_rule: Runtime saturation flag fires when sample's A-score on a substrate is within 0.005 of A_ceiling (i.e., A >= A_ceiling - 0.005). Saturated substrates are excluded from A_active aggregation per Reproduction Paper Part 3.3.

saturation_levels.v0_1_operational_note: v0.1 deployment runs on 450K/EPIC methylation arrays only. Methyl is the operational substrate at all tiers for all three modules. The non-methylation substrate guidance (nucl/fuzz/wps/frag) applies once the L2/L3 multi-assay platform is operational. Until then, A_ceiling(methyl, cycling) = 1.1681 for module_1 + module_2 primary tumor readout, A_ceiling(methyl, secretory) = 1.1859 for sub-cell-type tile readout, A_ceiling(methyl, immune) = 1.1921 for Stage 3 immune-fraction readout, with runtime flags firing 0.005 below ceiling.

per_tier_substrate_strategy_v_0_1_methyl._purpose: Per-tier substrate strategy at v0.1 is methyl-only across all three modules. Tier thresholds + atlas selection per tier follow universal_tier_thresholds (with disease-specific deviations documented per Block 7 tier_thresholds_per_substrate).

NORMAL.primary_atlases: All 5 Stage 2 atlases (Layered Moss+Loyfer, Boccellato, EsoRef, OEref, Caggiano TIM) + both Stage 3 atlases (Salas IDOL, UniLIFE)
NORMAL.notes: Run-everything: all atlases score every IDAT regardless of Stage 1 result. Display logic in patient report can collapse uninformative tiles.

MARGINAL.notes: MARGINAL flag triggers serial-sample at 6 months per universal cadence.

DETECTABLE.primary_atlases: Same — run-everything; clinical action triggers Stage 2 localization review per Pattern matrix
DETECTABLE.notes: DETECTABLE on cycling-class Stage 1 + Stage 2 atlas pattern matching → route per clinical_action_matrix Pattern A (gastric) / B (ESCC) / C (EAC) / E (IBD pathway) / F (no immediate culprit) / G (cross-tissue overread flag)

URGENT.notes: URGENT on Stage 1 with Pattern A/B/C/D match → expedited gastroenterology workup

FLOOR_BREACH.confirmation_rule: FLOOR_BREACH at v0.1 = methyl A ≥ 1.10 cycling-class on tumor cohort or A ≤ q5 floor on cell-of-origin secretory tile (cell-of-origin retention pattern in ESCC). Cross-substrate confirmation (≥2 unsaturated substrates above 1.10) is the v1.0+ rule once L2/L3 is operational.

saturation_levels.saturation_clinical_interpretation: When a runtime saturation flag fires for a substrate, that substrate is excluded from A_active aggregation per Reproduction Paper Part 3.3, and the patient EDEAR report carries a saturation alert for that substrate. The flag does NOT indicate disease severity — it indicates measurement-channel exhaustion. At v0.1 (methyl-only deployment), the only relevant saturation scenario is module_1/2 primary tumor methyl A approaching 1.1681 cycling-class ceiling or 1.1859 secretory-class ceiling on sub-cell-type tile readout, indicating the methyl channel is exhausted as a progression metric; continued progression must be tracked via Stage 2 cell-of-origin tile trajectory or, when L2 platform is operational, via fuzz/wps/frag.
saturation_levels.gastric_esophageal_specific_saturation_r: (1) Module_1 STAD primary tumor: tier-3 substrate baseline shift caps the cohort-level cycling-class methyl A-score below the 1.1681 ceiling on tumor samples (observed all-STAD d=+3.34 vs anchor; absolute A-magnitude is tier-3-invalidated under CHK-3.2). The methyl channel is operationally below saturation across the cohort. (2) Module_2 ESCA EAC subset: EAC's higher methylation drift (d=+3.70 vs ESCC's +2.64) approaches but does not breach the cycling-class ceiling on tumor cohort. (3) Module_3 Crohn's: Stage 3 immune-fraction readout operates on per-cell-type fractions not on H_min_immune ceiling; saturation rule does not apply structurally to cell-fraction outputs. (4) Boccellato secretory tile reading on STAD primary tumor: under tier-3 caveat, all 6 tiles read POSITIVE_UNEXPECTED relative to anchor; pre-locked NEGATIVE direction (cell-of-origin dedifferentiation) FAILS pre-lock. v0.2 substrate-matched gastric anchor is the path to clean interpretation.

stage_3_subcomposition._purpose: Stage 3 immune-fraction deconvolution via Salas IDOL 6-cell + UniLIFE 19-cell + Loyfer EPIC immune tiles + Caggiano TIM immune subset. All three modules use Stage 3 in different roles: module_1 + module_2 use it as immune-microenvironment readout; module_3 uses it as PRIMARY DEPLOYMENT READOUT for IBD population-fraction-shift detection.
stage_3_subcomposition.method: EpiDISH-style proportion estimation (Salas IDOL companion) + tile-coverage A-score (Loyfer immune EPIC tiles + UniLIFE 19-cell + Caggiano TIM immune subset). Substrate normalization per CHK-0.7 sesame Level 3 reference path.

module_1_stad_stage_3_findings.salas_idol_pattern: T-cell + myeloid depletion bidirectional pattern (CD4T -1.92, CD8T -1.58, Mono -0.90, NK -0.86, Neu -0.45, Bcell -0.20)
module_1_stad_stage_3_findings.interpretation: Consistent with Lin 2019 J Hepatol, Kang 2020 Theranostics, Sundar 2021 Nat Commun advanced gastric cancer immune evasion literature documenting peripheral T-cell exhaustion + reduced lymphocyte/myeloid blood-compartment proportions in advanced gastric cancer. Stage 3 immune signal is a within-tumor-cohort vs anchor-cohort reading; substrate baseline shift documented at CHK-3.2 affects absolute magnitudes but the direction reproduces published signature.
module_1_stad_stage_3_findings.operational_status: production-validated for module_1 deployment under tier-3 substrate caveat for absolute magnitudes

module_2_esca_stage_3_findings.salas_idol_pattern: Caggiano TIM panel fires consistent EAC > ESCC pattern across 13+ tiles at ~2 d-units within cohort (immune subset: tcell d_ESCC-EAC = -1.96, macrophage -2.08, neutrophil -2.09, monocyte -2.03)
module_2_esca_stage_3_findings.interpretation: Strongest ESCC vs EAC discriminator in the sprint. Caggiano TIM panel shows EAC's homogenized methylation pattern looking more like generic-epithelial tissue than ESCC's preserved squamous-specific structure across broad-cell-type panel.
module_2_esca_stage_3_findings.operational_status: Caggiano TIM panel is production-validated for ESCC vs EAC subtype discrimination at v0.1; full Salas + UniLIFE Stage 3 lineage profile pending v0.2 expansion (sample sizes per subtype and per Barrett's stratum sufficient for top tiles but underpowered for full 19-cell UniLIFE sub-classification)

cd_vs_uc_subtype_discrimination.interpretation: CD8 cells in CD show methylation patterns distinct from CD8 in UC (d=-0.72), suggesting CD8 immune phenotype is the cleanest CD-vs-UC discriminator at v0.1. Other cell types show only partial separation. Consistent with Strober et al. 2007 Nat Rev Immunol on CD's stronger Th1/CD8 effector memory signatures than UC's Th2-skewed presentation.

module_3_crohns_stage_3_findings_PRIMARY.interpretation: T-cells (CD4/CD8/Treg/NK) UP, monocytes/neutrophils DOWN. Classic immune-population-shift signature of active inflammatory bowel disease in peripheral blood. Cross-atlas reproduction across UniLIFE + Salas + Loyfer. PRIMARY DEPLOYMENT READOUT for module_3 amendment-language.
module_3_crohns_stage_3_findings_PRIMARY.operational_status: amendment-language scope at v0.1; not a deployed per-patient IBD-detection product; future IBD-epic v0.0 dedicated card construction sprint with v0.1.1 GSE87650 main n=384 cohort expansion is the path to per-patient deployment

mandatory_covariates_per_module._purpose: Every patient sample must be accompanied by mandatory clinical covariates appropriate to the disease module fired. The intake questionnaire requirements differ per module. Sex + age + ethnicity are universal across all three modules.

sex.rationale: Within-cohort male n=259 d=+3.42 vs female n=136 d=+3.20 (modest +0.22 d-unit male amplification); reported on all patient samples per universal_sex_stratification_rule.

age.rationale: Age-decade healthy reference per universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_class block; required to compute age-adjusted Z-score for tier classification.

ethnicity_race.rationale: TCGA-STAD ethnicity distribution available for stratified analysis but underpowered at v0.1; reported on all samples for v0.2 stratification expansion.

h_pylori_status.rationale: Within-cohort Yes n=20 d=+3.94 vs No n=168 d=+3.71; modest +0.23 d-unit amplification; underpowered at v0.1. Report Yes/No/Unknown per cBioPortal H_PYLORI_INFECTION coding. Relevant for clinical workup pathway (H. pylori eradication therapy + repeat screening).

ebv_serology.rationale: EBV+ subset overlaps with EBV molecular subtype (n=29 d=+3.85). Serology-positive-but-not-molecular-EBV samples reported separately. Relevant for clinical workup (tonsillar / nasopharyngeal exam if EBV+ without GI tumor).

msi_sensor_score.rationale: MSI_SENSOR_SCORE >= 4.0 = MSI-H per TCGA convention (n=67 d=+3.85 vs MSS n=326 d=+3.27); +0.58 d-unit MSI-H amplification. Relevant for immunotherapy eligibility (MSI-H predicts pembrolizumab response).

lauren_classification.rationale: intestinal-pooled n=158 d=+3.67 vs diffuse-pooled n=78 d=+3.29 vs mucinous n=20 d=+3.92 vs adenoNOS n=134 d=+3.09. Pathologist-reported on biopsy.

family_history_gastric_cancer.rationale: Hereditary diffuse gastric cancer (CDH1 germline mutation) is a distinct clinical entity warranting prophylactic gastrectomy per international consortium guidelines. Family-history-positive patients route to genetic counseling regardless of methylation result.

anatomic_subsite.rationale: ICD-10 C16.0-C16.9 subsite reported on biopsy. Relevant for v0.2 Boccellato sub-tile resolution (Antrum vs Corpus vs Fundus).

prior_gastric_ulcer_disease.rationale: Chronic gastritis + atrophic gastritis precursor states; relevant for clinical context.

smoking_status.rationale: Smoking is a moderate gastric cancer risk factor per IARC; not strongly stratified at v0.1 (TCGA-STAD smoking metadata sparse). Reported on all samples for v0.2 expansion.

sex.rationale: Within-cohort male n=158 d=+2.84 vs female n=27 d=+3.10 (note male-skewed cohort, female n underpowered at v0.1). Reported on all patient samples.

age.rationale: Same as module_1; required for age-adjusted Z.

ethnicity_race.rationale: ESCC predominates in East Asian populations vs EAC in Western populations — major epidemiological pattern. Reported on all samples.

histology.rationale: ESCC vs EAC = primary subtype-discrimination axis. d_ESCC-EAC = -1.06 within cohort (p=1.50e-11). Required pathology-confirmed input.

barrett_esophagus_history.rationale: MOST IMPORTANT MODULE_2 COVARIATE. Within-cohort Barrett+ n=28 d=+4.50 vs Barrett- n=118 d=+2.81 (+1.69 d-units). Required for EAC-arm patient-report routing. Specify prior diagnosis date if known + subsequent surveillance protocol.

smoking_status_pack_years.rationale: Within-cohort smoking informative null (all four strata within 0.6 d-units); but smoking is a major epidemiological risk factor for ESCC per IARC. Pack-years required for clinical context (mean 34.5 in TCGA-ESCA cohort).

alcohol_consumption_frequency.rationale: Major ESCC risk factor (especially in combination with smoking + ALDH2 polymorphism in East Asian populations). cBioPortal alcohol consumption frequency available; within-cohort stratification preserved for v0.2.

gerd_reflux_symptoms.rationale: Major EAC risk factor; clinical context for Barrett's surveillance routing.

columnar_metaplasia_documented.rationale: Imaging or pathology-documented; secondary to Barrett's-positive status.

msi_sensor_esca.rationale: ESCA cohort low-MSI overall; reported but not load-bearing at v0.1.

sex.rationale: Within-cohort sex distribution M=126 F=114 in GSE87650 sub-experiment; sex stratification preserved for v0.1.1 main cohort expansion.

age.rationale: Required for age-adjusted Z; IBD diagnosis age informs pediatric vs adult-onset stratification.

ibd_disease_subtype.rationale: Crohn's vs ulcerative colitis vs IBD-unclassified. Within-cohort modest CD vs UC discrimination at v0.1 (CD8 d_CD-UC = -0.72 cleanest).

ibd_disease_activity_state.rationale: Active flare vs remission — major confounder for immune-fraction shifts; clinical metadata not consistently captured in GSE87650 v0.1; pending v0.1.1 expansion.

current_medications.rationale: Anti-TNF biologics (infliximab, adalimumab), corticosteroids (prednisone), immunomodulators (azathioprine, methotrexate) ALL alter peripheral immune-fraction profile. Pending v0.1.1 expansion + dedicated treatment-stratified VAL.

cancer_comorbidity_screening.rationale: If module_3 fires AND module_1 or module_2 ALSO fires, the patient may have coincident GI cancer + IBD. Clinically plausible per Marcus's stepbrother case (Crohn's + HCC). Trigger careful cross-module workup.

tier_thresholds_per_substrate._caveat: v0.1 deploys methyl-only across all three modules. Tier thresholds below apply to methyl substrate. Non-methyl substrate thresholds deferred to v1.0+ MESA platform integration.

The pattern is most consistent with [CIN-like / MSI-like / EBV-like / GS-like] subtype based on within-cohort comparison, though this is a research-grade signal not a diagnosis. Recommended next step: gastroenterology referral for upper endoscopy (EGD) with biopsy, and H. pylori testing if you are 45 or older.

Pattern_B_ESCC_suspicion.guideline_citation: NCCN Guidelines for Esophageal and Esophagogastric Junction Cancers v.2.2026; ASGE 2019; ACR 2020 imaging appropriateness criteria for esophageal cancer
Pattern_B_ESCC_suspicion.patient_report_template: Your methylation profile shows a pattern consistent with squamous-cell carcinoma of the esophagus, with cell-of-origin markers pointing toward squamous-stratified esophageal epithelium. Recommended next step: gastroenterology referral for upper endoscopy with biopsy.

Pattern_C_EAC_suspicion.patient_report_template: Your methylation profile shows a pattern consistent with esophageal adenocarcinoma, often associated with Barrett's esophagus history. Within-cohort findings (subtype hierarchy, Barrett's amplification, ESCC vs EAC discrimination, IBD population-fraction shifts) are robust to the CHK-3.2 tier-3 substrate baseline shift documented for STAD (-5.02 anchor-SD) and ESCA (-4.31 anchor-SD) and form the load-bearing v0.1 deployment narrative. Absolute cross-cohort d-magnitudes are reported under explicit tier-3 invalidation language and are NOT load-bearing for v0.1 deployment. v0.2 path: substrate-matched gastric+esophageal anchor (additional GI adjacent-normal HM450 cohorts beyond TCGA's n=2 / n=16) bypasses the tier-3 caveat for absolute Boccellato + EsoRef direction interpretation and promotes the card to multi_atlas_calibrated_substrate_matched_anchor.
known_limitations: CHK-3.2 tier-3 substrate baseline shift on TCGA HM450 sesame Level 3 STAD (-5.02 anchor-SD) and ESCA (-4.31 anchor-SD) vs KIRC+PRAD anchor invalidates absolute cross-cohort d-magnitudes for cell-of-origin direction interpretation; within-cohort contrasts immune to baseline shift are the load-bearing v0.1 findings. v0.2 substrate-matched gastric+esophageal anchor is the documented path forward.

Pre-locked Boccellato gastric tile direction prediction (NEGATIVE consistent with cell-of-origin dedifferentiation) FAILS pre-lock on STAD primary tumor under tier-3 caveat. All 6 Boccellato tiles read POSITIVE_UNEXPECTED. Cannot separate substrate-shift effect from tumor-methylation-homogenization within VAL-126 because both contributions go in the same direction under tier-3 invalidation.

EsoRef cross-tissue overread observed on STAD adenocarcinoma (3 of 4 squamous tiles fire DIFFERENTIATING_CROSS_TISSUE_OVERREAD) and EAC adenocarcinoma may be generic atlas overread OR Barrett's-derived methylation memory propagating through columnar adenocarcinomas across the GI continuum. The kidney-card cross-card calibration test (running EsoRef on TCGA-KIRC tumor) is the discriminating experiment, not yet completed at v0.1.

Module_3 Crohn's pathway amendment is supported at v0.1 by n=65 whole-blood-companion subset + n=175 sorted-cell sub-experiment from GSE87650 GPL13534 series matrix. The Ventham main whole-blood cohort n=384 lives in supplementary file (1.4 GB compressed) requiring separate download + preprocessing; queued for v0.1.1 expansion. v0.1 amendment language is supported but not yet at full statistical power.

Module_3 does NOT produce a per-patient IBD-detection score at v0.1. The signature is a Stage 3 immune-population-fraction shift detected by existing cell-fraction deconvolution atlases. A dedicated IBD-discriminating panel (top 20-30 CpGs from VAL-128 Stage 3 whole-blood findings) is the path to a clean per-patient IBD-specific A-score, tracked for future IBD-epic v0.0 sprint NOT in scope for gastric+esophageal-epic.

lessons_learned.title: Within-cohort molecular-subtype hierarchy is robust under CHK-3.2 tier-3 substrate baseline shift
lessons_learned.observation: When a card's primary cohort sits on a different substrate baseline than the calibration anchor (CHK-3.2 tier-3 shift detected), absolute cross-cohort d-magnitudes are invalidated by the baseline shift, but within-cohort molecular-subtype d-hierarchies are immune to the baseline shift because all subtypes share the same baseline. VAL-126 STAD demonstrates: substrate shift -5.02 anchor-SD invalidates absolute d-magnitudes for cell-of-origin direction interpretation, but the within-cohort hierarchy MSI ≈ EBV > CIN > POLE ≈ GS preserves the prereg-predicted CIMP-amplification ordering with high resolution.
lessons_learned.implication: When CHK-3.2 fires tier-3, the within-cohort molecular-subtype hierarchy block becomes the primary load-bearing analytical layer for the card v0.1 deployment narrative; cell-of-origin direction predictions get explicitly flagged as pending-substrate-matched-anchor. Add to TESTING_CHECKLIST CHK-3.2 section. Promotes to CCL-### in next LESSONS_LEARNED.md cycle.

lessons_learned.title: ESCC vs EAC subtype discrimination on methylation alone via Caggiano TIM panel — first cookbook example of within-cancer histological-subtype methylation discrimination at >1 d-unit magnitude outside MSI-tracking-Lauren cases
lessons_learned.observation: Caggiano TIM panel produces consistent EAC > ESCC pattern across 13+ tiles (~2 d-units within cohort, p=1.5e-11 on Stage 1 alone). Interpretable as EAC's homogenized methylation pattern looking more like generic-epithelial tissue than ESCC's preserved squamous-specific structure — i.e., EAC has lost more cell-type-specific methylation than ESCC. d_ESCC-EAC = -1.06 on Stage 1 alone within cohort.
lessons_learned.implication: Cards covering cancers with multiple distinct histological subtypes should pre-lock magnitude-based |d_subtype1-subtype2| ≥ 0.5 as a discrimination criterion. The Caggiano TIM panel's broad-cell-type coverage is particularly useful for histological-subtype discrimination because biologically distinct subtypes (e.g., ESCC squamous transformation vs EAC Barrett's-CIMP) produce different methylation drift patterns across the panel's 19 cell-type tiles. Future card preregs targeting cancers with multiple histological subtypes should include the Caggiano TIM panel as a primary discrimination atlas.

lessons_learned.title: Gene-promoter atlas reads target biology in target subtype (EsoRef Epi_stratified d=-0.99 in ESCC, near-null in EAC) — first cookbook example
lessons_learned.observation: EsoRef Epi_stratified tile reads d=-0.99 in ESCC squamous-cell carcinoma (squamous tumor retains methylation patterns consistent with squamous-stratified epithelial origin) and d=-0.05 in EAC adenocarcinoma (cell-of-origin signature lost). First cookbook example of a gene-promoter atlas reading its target biology in one disease subtype within the same multi-cohort sprint. The cross-tissue overread observed on STAD adenocarcinoma + EAC adenocarcinoma may reframe as Barrett's-derived methylation memory propagating through columnar adenocarcinomas across the GI continuum, not generic atlas overread.
lessons_learned.implication: Gene-promoter atlases applied to multi-subtype cancer cohorts should be evaluated per-subtype rather than at cohort level. The DIFFERENTIATING_CROSS_TISSUE_OVERREAD outcome class is now bidirectional: when a gene-promoter atlas reads strong in cohorts of non-target tissue, the appropriate test for whether the signal is genuine cross-tissue gene-promoter biology or atlas overread is a within-cohort subtype split on a target-tissue-adjacent cohort. The kidney-card cross-card calibration test (running EsoRef on TCGA-KIRC tumor) is the discriminating experiment, sharpened by this finding.

lessons_learned.title: Risk-factor amplification within cancer cohort (Barrett's +1.69 d-units within ESCA) is robust to substrate baseline shift
lessons_learned.observation: Within-cohort risk-factor stratification produces interpretable amplification signal even under tier-3 substrate baseline shift because the risk-factor-positive and risk-factor-negative subgroups share the same baseline. Barrett+ ESCA (n=28) Stage 1 d=+4.50 vs Barrett- ESCA (n=118) d=+2.81 = +1.69 d-units within cohort. Smoking (n=37 current vs n=56 lifelong-non) NULL (within 0.6 d-units) — informative null distinguishing methylation-drift mechanisms from mutational-burden mechanisms.
lessons_learned.implication: Every multi-cohort card should pre-lock at least one within-cohort risk-factor stratification when clinical metadata supports it (Barrett's for esophageal, MSI status for STAD, H. pylori for gastric, pack-years for lung, BMI/diabetes for HCC, family history for breast, etc.). Within-cohort risk-factor stratification is the cleanest signal under tier-3 substrate caveat. Add to TESTING_CHECKLIST and LESSONS_LEARNED.

lessons_learned.title: Mixture-attenuation reversal — Stage 3 deconvolution atlases measure cell-type composition not within-cell-type drift
lessons_learned.observation: Pre-locked test: sorted-cell d should be ≥ 1.5x whole-blood d (mixture-attenuation hypothesis: separating cells should AMPLIFY within-cell-type drift signal). Observed: 40/93 tiles pass (43%) — whole blood is STRONGER than sorted cells. Direction is REVERSED from prereg expectation. Crohn's produces methylation signature primarily through population-fraction shifts. When cells are sorted, the population-shift signal is gone by definition. Stage 3 atlases (Salas IDOL, Loyfer immune tiles, UniLIFE 19-cell, Caggiano TIM) detect proportional shifts in mixed populations; in sorted cells there is no shift to detect. This is not a refutation of the Stage 3 atlases — it is a clarification of what Stage 3 measures.
lessons_learned.implication: Stage 3 deconvolution atlases measure cell-type composition shifts in mixed-population substrates, not within-cell-type chronic-inflammation drift. Cards interpreting Stage 3 results should anchor the interpretation in population-fraction-shift language ('T-cell expansion + myeloid depletion in whole blood') not within-cell-type-drift language. Future card preregs should pre-specify whether the disease is expected to drive a population-fraction shift (IBD, viral infection, sepsis) vs a within-cell-type drift (TIL exhaustion in solid tumor microenvironment). Re-frames Stage 3 interpretation across the cookbook.
extends: Re-frames Stage 3 deconvolution-atlas interpretation across the cookbook

lessons_learned.title: Stage 1 cycling-class architectural-drift panel does NOT detect IBD — informative null clarifying Stage 1 specificity
lessons_learned.observation: Xu-538 Stage 1 panel produces |d_CD-HC| < 0.5 across all four cell-type strata (monocytes, CD4, CD8, wh blood) on GSE87650 Crohn's cohort. UC vs HC similar near-null. Class-of-disease finding: IBD does not register on cycling-class Stage 1 panel. Stage 1 is tissue/cancer-specific (validated previously on TCGA-COAD, TCGA-LIHC, TCGA-STAD, TCGA-ESCA, GSE51057 breast) not generic chronic-inflammation marker.
lessons_learned.implication: Stage 1 Xu-538 cycling-class architectural-drift panel is specific to tissue/cancer cycling acceleration, not generic chronic-inflammation. Card preregs targeting chronic-inflammatory diseases (IBD, autoimmune, chronic viral infection) should NOT pre-lock Stage 1 elevation as a primary outcome and should expect Stage 3 immune-fraction shifts to be the load-bearing readout instead. Stage 1 panel scope clarification across cookbook.
extends: Stage 1 panel scope clarification across cookbook
